NORTHERN AREAS PROTECTION OF BREAST-FEEDING AND CHILD NUTRITION
ORDINANCE (ADAPTATION AND ENFORCEMENT) ORDER, 2003
An Order to extend and apply the Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child
Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 (XCIII of 2002) to Northern Areas
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, dated 15th September,
2003]
S.R.O. 909(I)/2003, dated 6-9-2003.---Whereas it is expedient to
extend and apply the Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition
Ordinance, 2002 (XCIII Of 2002) to Northern Areas for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by of the Northern Area. Council Legal Framework Order,
Government of Pakistan is pleased to make the namely:
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This order may be
called the Northern Areas Protection of Breast-Feeding and Child Nutrition
Ordinance (Adaptation and Enforcement) Order, 2003.
(2) It extends to whole of
Northern Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Adaptation and enforcement of the Protection of Breast-Feeding and
Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 (XCIII of 2002).--The Protection of Breast-Feeding
and Child Nutrition Ordinance, 2002 (XCIII of 2002) as in force in Pakistan
immediately before the commencement of this order, is adapted and shall, as far
as practicable apply and be in force in Northern Areas subject to
modifications, and in its application shall have effect as if reference therein---
(a) to
"Provincial Government" were a reference to the Government of
Northern Areas;
(b) to
"High Court" were a reference to the Chief Court, Northern Areas; and
(c) to "'Chief Justice" were a reference to the
Chairman, Chief Court, Northern Areas.
